financials_interim.notes: Source: Cable Solutions PLC (CSLK) Interim Financial Statements for the Three Months Ended 30 June 2026 (unaudited, board-approved 13 Aug 2026), downloaded from CSE cdn (source_id 52585). This is the FIRST financial_statements row for CSLK in this DB with a proper income-statement/balance-sheet/cashflow entry -- prior local documents (period ended 31 Dec 2024, 30 Sep 2025) were superseded/never entered into financial_statements. Filing has NO standalone quarter/cumulative distinction issue since CSLK's financial year runs Apr-Mar and this is Q1, so the 'Quarter ended' and 'Period ended' columns are identical (both three months) -- confirmed by cross-checking the two column sets on p.3, which are numerically identical. Separate GROUP and COMPANY columns given throughout -> entered as two rows per project convention. Group = Cable Solutions PLC consolidated with its India cable-assembly manufacturing subsidiary; Company = Cable Solutions PLC standalone. CSLK is 51%-owned by ACL Cables PLC (itself also in this DB) -- see 20-largest-shareholders note p.12. Figures entered in LKR (whole rupees, NOT thousands -- filing states amounts in whole LKR, e.g. Revenue Rs.988,146,397) with unit_scale='1', differing from most other symbols in this DB which report in Rs'000 -- flagged explicitly since insert_financial_statements() warns on unit_scale drift vs a symbol's own prior row (none exists yet for CSLK so no warning expected, but future CSLK entries must also use unit_scale='1' to stay consistent). The filing ALSO presents a full duplicate set of statements in USD (functional currency of the enterprise per Note 1.3/2.3, p.11) on pages 14-20 -- not used for this entry since the DB's currency convention is LKR; USD Q1 FY2026/27 Group PAT was USD302,138 (2025: USD448,536, -33%) for cross-reference only, not stored. Income statement (GROUP): p.3. Income statement (COMPANY): p.5. Balance sheet (both bases): p.7. Cash flow statement (both bases): p.8. Key ratios note: p.11-12. Mapping: operating_profit = 'Results from operating activities' (Group 127,077,972 vs 169,679,880 PY; Company 137,101,459 vs 177,028,585 PY). finance_costs = 'Net finance Income/(Expense)' magnitude (6,414,765, IDENTICAL for both Group and Company -- the filing discloses only a single NET finance line with no gross income/expense split, same presentation gap noted in this DB's ACL entry) -- stored as a NET COST (finance costs field, finance_income left at 0) since the line is negative (an expense) in both years, unlike ACL where the net line was a net INCOME; sign convention differs company-to-company by what the net line actually represents. trade_receivables = 'Trade and other receivables' only (Group 1,721,623,015; Company 1,728,497,504); excludes 'Amounts due from related parties' (Group 47,942,524; Company 180,821,148, a large and NOT fully explained related-party balance for Company given Company's own revenue is only ~988mn) -- kept out to avoid double counting, not separately fielded. short_term_borrowings = current 'Interest bearing borrowings' + 'Bank overdrafts' combined (405,132,281 + 12,372,845 = 417,505,126, identical for both bases since both are wholly at the Company level per the SOFP -- India subsidiary appears to carry no separate debt). long_term_borrowings = non-current 'Interest bearing borrowings' line, which is explicitly NIL ('-') for both periods and both bases -- CSLK carries no long-term debt, all borrowings are short-term/overdraft. capex = 'Purchase of property, plant and equipment' from the cash flow statement, which is explicitly NIL ('-') this quarter for both Group and Company (PY: 8,046,341) -- CSLK made no PPE purchases in Q1 FY2026/27, a genuine finding not a data gap. cash_from_investing = 0 for the same reason (only PPE purchase and nil disposal proceeds populate this section this quarter). EPS basic 0.2105 (Group) cross-checks to PAT-to-owners 99,085,494 / 470,666,600 shares = 0.2106, matches printed 0.2105 (rounding); Company EPS 0.2318 cross-checks to 109,107,979 / 470,666,600 = 0.2318, exact match. PBT-tax-PAT identity holds for both bases. Shares in issue 470,666,600 per Note 07/08 (p.12-13), unchanged since the July 2024 public share issue (Note 06). DATA-QUALITY FLAG: the Company-basis Statement of Profit or Loss on p.5 (row 'Gross profit') contains a PDF text-extraction artifact -- an overlapping/garbled text fragment reading '...The IPO of the company took place subsequent to the reporting period...' is interleaved character-by-character with the gross-profit figures (277,790,826 / 294,265,537). This numeric figures either side of the garbled text are legible and internally consistent (987,090,852 - 709,300,026 = 277,790,826, matches) and were used; the 'IPO subsequent to reporting period' fragment is judged to be a stray/overlapping text layer in the source PDF (CSLK's public share issue already occurred in July 2024 per Note 06, so a fresh IPO note as at Aug 2026 would be inconsistent with known facts) and is NOT treated as a genuine disclosure -- flagged here rather than silently discarded or wrongly reported as a real subsequent event.

interim_updates.note_text: Cable Solutions PLC (CSLK, 51%-owned by ACL Cables PLC) reported Group Revenue of Rs.988.15mn for Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026), up 10.8% YoY from Rs.891.86mn -- per the filing's own Financial Review (p.1), growth was 'mainly driven by higher export and deemed export sales, supported by new customer acquisitions and increased order volumes from existing customers'. Despite the topline growth, profitability fell: Gross Profit declined 5.1% YoY to Rs.275.73mn (2025: Rs.290.57mn), with Gross Profit Margin down to 27.9% from 32.6% PY, which the Financial Review explicitly attributes to 'higher copper prices and manufacturing costs' outpacing revenue growth -- Cost of Sales grew 18.5% YoY (Rs.712.42mn vs Rs.601.29mn) against 10.8% revenue growth. Results from Operating Activities fell 25.1% YoY to Rs.127.08mn (2025: Rs.169.68mn), a decline the Financial Review attributes to 'higher administrative expenses arising from salary revisions, operational expansion, and inflationary cost pressures' -- Administrative Expenses rose 23.4% YoY to Rs.118.43mn (2025: Rs.96.02mn) and Distribution Expenses rose 21.5% YoY to Rs.30.23mn (2025: Rs.24.88mn), both growing well ahead of revenue. Profit Before Tax fell 25.9% YoY to Rs.120.66mn (2025: Rs.162.85mn) and Profit for the Period fell 26.4% YoY to Rs.99.08mn (2025: Rs.134.52mn), with Basic EPS down to Rs.0.2105 from Rs.0.2858. Net Finance Expense was broadly flat, -6.1% YoY to Rs.6.41mn (2025: Rs.6.83mn), not a material driver either way. Income Tax Expense fell 23.8% YoY to Rs.21.58mn (2025: Rs.28.33mn), roughly proportionate to the smaller pretax profit base (effective tax rate 17.9% this quarter vs 17.4% PY, essentially unchanged). Company (standalone) results moved in the same direction and by similar magnitudes: revenue +11.8% YoY to Rs.987.09mn, PBT -23.2% YoY to Rs.130.69mn, PAT -23.1% YoY to Rs.109.11mn -- the Company slightly outperformed Group on the topline (its India cable-assembly subsidiary is still loss-making or immaterial, per the Financial Review noting 'the subsidiary remains in its growth phase'). Notably, CSLK made ZERO capital expenditure this quarter (Purchase of Property, Plant and Equipment: nil, both bases; PY: Rs.8.05mn), and Net Cash Used in Operating Activities was Rs.(152.54)mn (2025: Rs.(36.04)mn used), a materially larger cash drain driven by a Rs.214.55mn increase in Inventories and a Rs.349.06mn increase in Trade and Other Receivables during the quarter -- funded by Rs.469.75mn of new borrowings drawn (net Rs.62.88mn financing inflow after Rs.406.87mn of repayments).
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: this is CSLK's first financial_statements/interim_updates entry in this DB (prior local documents, periods ended 31 Dec 2024 and 30 Sep 2025, were never entered into financial_statements) -- only YoY (vs the filing's own 3-months-ended-30-June-2025 comparative column) is computed. Unlike BALA and ACL, CSLK's filing DOES include a Financial Review/MD&A section (p.1), so the copper-price and cost-driver commentary above is company-stated, not inferred. Genuine filing-level gaps: (1) the filing does not quantify how much of the 18.5% cost-of-sales growth is attributable to copper price inflation specifically versus volume growth versus other manufacturing costs -- the Financial Review names copper prices and manufacturing costs together without a breakdown; (2) the India subsidiary's standalone revenue/profit contribution is not separately disclosed (no subsidiary-level segment note), only the qualitative statement that it 'remains in its growth phase'; (3) a large and materially growing 'Amounts due from related parties' balance (Company: Rs.180.82mn, up from Rs.122.06mn at 31 Mar 2026) is not explained -- likely intercompany balances with parent ACL Cables PLC or the India subsidiary, but the nature is not itemised; (4) a PDF text-extraction artifact on the Company P&L page (p.5) contains a garbled fragment referencing an 'IPO... subsequent to the reporting period', judged spurious/overlapping template text since CSLK's public share issue already occurred in July 2024 -- flagged in the financial_statements notes, not treated as a real subsequent event here.
interim_updates.takeaway: CSLK's Q1 FY2026/27 is a classic margin-squeeze story that the company itself explains clearly: revenue grew a healthy 10.8% on stronger export demand, but elevated copper prices and cost inflation (salary revisions, operational expansion) pulled gross margin down nearly 470bps (32.6% to 27.9%) and operating profit down 25.1%, flowing through to a 26.4% PAT decline. Unlike BALA and ACL, this driver is company-disclosed rather than inferred, which increases confidence in the read. The bigger flag for the next quarter is working capital: CSLK drew down Rs.469.75mn of fresh borrowings to fund a Rs.152.54mn operating cash outflow while making zero capital expenditure, suggesting cash is being consumed by receivables/inventory growth rather than reinvestment -- worth watching if copper prices stay elevated and receivables keep building.
operational_highlights: Group Revenue Rs.988.15mn, +10.8% YoY (2025: Rs.891.86mn); Gross Profit Rs.275.73mn, -5.1% YoY, margin 27.9% (2025: 32.6%); Operating profit Rs.127.08mn, -25.1% YoY; PBT Rs.120.66mn, -25.9% YoY; PAT Rs.99.08mn, -26.4% YoY; EPS Rs.0.2105 (2025: Rs.0.2858).

Company-stated driver (Financial Review, p.1): revenue growth 'mainly driven by higher export and deemed export sales'; margin decline explicitly attributed to 'higher copper prices and manufacturing costs' outpacing revenue growth.
Administrative expenses +23.4% YoY to Rs.118.43mn and Distribution expenses +21.5% YoY to Rs.30.23mn, company-attributed to 'salary revisions, operational expansion, and inflationary cost pressures'.

Zero capital expenditure this quarter (2025: Rs.8.05mn); Net Cash Used in Operating Activities widened to Rs.(152.54)mn (2025: Rs.(36.04)mn) on a Rs.214.55mn inventory build and Rs.349.06mn receivables increase, funded by Rs.469.75mn of new borrowings drawn.
Company (standalone) PBT -23.2% YoY to Rs.130.69mn, PAT -23.1% YoY to Rs.109.11mn -- broadly tracking Group given the India subsidiary remains small/early-stage.
key_drivers: Company-stated: elevated global copper prices plus general manufacturing cost inflation compressed gross margin from 32.6% to 27.9%, the primary driver of the profit decline despite double-digit revenue growth.

Administrative and distribution expense growth (+23.4% and +21.5% YoY respectively), company-attributed to salary revisions and operational expansion, further eroded operating profit beyond the gross-margin effect.
A large working-capital build (inventories +Rs.214.55mn, receivables +Rs.349.06mn) drove a sharp widening in operating cash outflow, funded by fresh borrowings rather than internally generated cash.

_gaps: ebitda: depreciation_amortization not disclosed; EBITDA understated (= operating profit only)
